inputs.description: Parsed data/project.json plus exactly its referenced data/maps and data/database JSON shards.
Compiled GameBundle v1; never raw editor/project state.
Warnings from the exact successful GameBundle compilation used for this release.

releaseDecision.allowWhen: all checks have zero error issues
releaseDecision.denyWhen: any check has one or more error issues
releaseDecision.mutationPolicy: fail-closed; validator does not redact or repair release inputs

checks.assertion: Release manifest is JSON-safe, uses schemaVersion 1, and contains only declared contract fields.
Target is windows-portable, artifact is a portable directory or zip, and architecture is x64 or arm64.
Input is a compiled GameBundle v1 with project, maps, items, databases, and only runtime asset fields.
GameBundle contains no circular, undefined, executable, or non-finite JSON values.
Compiler warning evidence is present and contains no secret-redacted warning; a release must fail instead of silently shipping a redacted build.
The native project is schema v1, has a valid start map, and declares only map/database references understood by the native runtime.
Asset ids are explicit, canonical, non-blank, and unique case-insensitively.
GameBundle assets and the explicit allowlist are an exact one-to-one set.
Every bundled asset is marked runtimeCompatible true.
Every allowlisted asset has exactly one asset-role file and no non-allowlisted file is shipped below assets/.
Asset paths are canonical Windows-safe relative paths below assets/ and agree across bundle and file inventory.
data/project.json, referenced maps, and recognized database shards form one deterministic exact allowlist with no missing, duplicate, extra, traversing, or mis-typed entry.
Every and only allowlisted asset has one sidecar record with non-blank origin and user-confirmed license note.
Provenance assetId, runtimePath, and source match the corresponding GameBundle asset.
Generated assets record provider, model, operation, timestamp, and output SHA-256 matching the shipped bytes; raw prompts/responses are not allowed.
No recursively nested property name matches the shared portable-sensitive-key policy.
No string matches centralized redaction behavior or common OpenAI, Google, GitHub, Slack, AWS, bearer, or private-key credential patterns.
Runtime-loadable fields cannot reference network, file, content, data, or other external URI schemes.
Extracted-tree inventory is exhaustive, uses known roles, declared fields only, and unique case-insensitive paths.
Colocated launcher/runtime executables, canonical native project and every referenced map/database shard, GameBundle and provenance sidecars, README, and license are present with correct roles.
Paths are forward-slash canonical, project-relative, traversal/ADS free, and avoid Windows device names and trailing dots/spaces.
Every shipped file has a positive safe byte size and lower-case SHA-256.
Release contains no source trees, tests, caches, backups, saves/logs, credential stores, signing material, debug symbols, source maps, temp files, or build intermediates.
Release inventory, individual files, asset catalogs, provenance, and compiler evidence stay within bounded structural and byte limits.
